text: Klíč máš. Teď potřebuješ plán, lidi a někoho, kdo ti ten plán orazítkuje.
pokyny: Voice acting for a comedy point-and-click adventure game. Speak Czech with native pronunciation, natural pacing and comic timing. Do not read stage directions. Character: Prof. Pembok, elderly professor and narrator-mentor, dry wit, slow and precise. Delivery: instructively.
